purples.songTitle: Tell the Devil I’m Gettin’ There as Fast as I Can
purples.line: Now the faithless live in grays and faded purples
stanza: Now the faithless live in grays and faded purples
And the gamblers never bet on 12's or 2's
The drunken poets disappear into big shadows
And the rock 'n' roll believers sing the easy rider blues
